# GeminiWatermark.ai

> GeminiWatermark.ai is a free online tool that removes the visible watermark from Google Gemini AI-generated images, and (with Pro) from Google Veo AI-generated videos. It uses deterministic reverse alpha blending — a mathematically exact inversion of the watermark compositing equation — so the original pixels are restored with no quality loss, no generative fill, and no hallucinated content. Images are processed in seconds; no signup is required for up to 3 images per day.

Key facts:
- Removes the visible Gemini watermark (both the current Gemini 3.5 layout and the legacy pre-3.5 layout, auto-detected).
- Video: removes the Gemini diamond and the small "Veo" text watermark from Veo/Flow videos, 720p and 1080p, landscape and portrait. Audio is preserved and frame timing stays exact.
- Does NOT remove SynthID. SynthID is Google's invisible, pixel-level watermark and cannot be removed without destroying the image. Only the visible corner logo is removed.
- Privacy: files are processed in memory on the server and deleted within an hour; nothing is stored or used for training.
- Free tier: 3 images/day, no account. Pro ($4.99/month): unlimited images, batch upload of multiple images at once, and Veo video removal (10 videos/day).
- Works in any browser on desktop and mobile; input formats JPG, PNG, WebP (images) and MP4, MOV, MKV (video).

## How it works

The Gemini watermark is alpha-blended onto the image: watermarked = original x (1 - alpha) + logo x alpha. Because the alpha map and logo are known and calibrated, the original can be recovered exactly: original = (watermarked - logo x alpha) / (1 - alpha). This is deterministic math, not AI inpainting — identical input always produces identical output, and unwatermarked regions are untouched. Images without a detectable watermark are left unmodified and reported as such.
